messages.subject: Project Quartz - draft Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor,

Draft Heads of Terms attached reflecting the £42.5m enterprise value and the structure we discussed: cash at completion, a 12-month retention and deferred consideration on the first anniversary. Exclusivity to 31 March 2026. Subject to contract throughout save the binding clauses.

Grateful for comments before we send to Ashworth Quinn.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
